2. The petitioner is in judicial custody in connection Since 19 with Hiramma P.S. Case No. 89 of 2022 registered under Sections 363 and 366A of the Indian Penal Code and subsequently Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act was added lodged on 15.12.2022 by the informant, Pappu Mahto.

4. The report of the S.P. Sheohar has been perused and the file stands consigned.
